patch_description: Currently the CRZ entangling ring in Layer 2 shares a single parameter "b" with the following CRX ring across all 8 edges, giving the model very coarse control over its phase-type entanglement pattern. Following the recommendation, we split the CRZ ring into two independent phase parameters: even-indexed edges (0-1, 2-3, 4-5, 6-7) keep using "b" (still shared with the CRX ring, preserving most of the parameter economy), while odd-indexed edges (1-2, 3-4, 5-6, 7-0) now use a new parameter "d". This gives the ansatz one extra degree of freedom to independently tune phase correlations on the two interleaved sub-rings, which should let it adapt its entangling profile more precisely to the hardest validation groups while only increasing the distinct parameter count from 3 to 4 — a small, well-justified cost given the potential robustness gain.
